pages.brief: Fig the green caterpillar on a leaf, looking down at something small, round and silver glinting on the ground below in the hedge.
Fig the caterpillar close beside a small round silver button lying among fallen leaves at the base of the hedge.
Fig the caterpillar nudging a small silver button with his head, the button rolling a little across the leaves.
Fig the caterpillar leaning in close, sniffing a silver button, looking puzzled.
Fig the caterpillar tucking a small silver button safely under a big green leaf in the hedge.
Fig the caterpillar patting a green leaf over his hidden treasure, looking pleased with himself.
